Speaker: Root
Text: So you're the ones tearing through the system. Impressive. Reckless, but impressive.

Speaker: Kael
Text: We need to stop the Kernel and reach the core crystal.

Speaker: Root
Text: The Kernel won't go down easy. It has root access to everything. But so do I.

Speaker: Root
Text: Consider this a partnership. Beat the Kernel, and I'll make sure the Nexus doesn't crash.
